title: Delivery & Pickup Services Tariff Rules: Charging Order Fees
content:
Order fees on a Delivery & Pickup Services plan are charged on these rules.

## Rules in force

1. **Plan in force.** Order fees are set by the plan in force on the day the order is placed.
2. **Same-day fee.** A same-day order is charged the plan's same-day fee, waived when the order value is at or above the plan's free same-day threshold and that threshold is above $0.00.
3. **Mail fee.** A standard mail order is charged the plan's mail fee.
4. **Distance fee.** A courier order whose road distance is above the plan's free delivery radius is also charged the plan's distance fee.
5. **Redelivery fee.** A redelivery is charged the plan's redelivery fee.
6. **Once per order.** Each fee type is charged at most once per order, and a waived fee is not charged at all rather than charged and refunded.
7. **Rewards free prescription delivery.** A patient who holds a Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status whose level carries free prescription delivery is charged no same-day or express fee on an order that carries prescriptions, whatever the delivery plan; distance and redelivery fees still apply.
8. **Free express allowance.** The free express allowance of a plan is the plan's free express orders per calendar month. The express orders counted against it are the plan's express orders scheduled in the calendar month of the order's scheduled date on which no express fee was charged, cancelled orders not counted.

## Clauses no longer in force

- *"An express order is charged the plan's express fee, waived while the free express count is below the free express orders per month."* This clause is **no longer in force**; the express fee is set by the current express fee basis for Delivery & Pickup Services, which supersedes it.
- *"Where the plan is past due and plan prices stop applying while past due, the Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery fees apply instead."* This clause is **no longer in force**; the pricing of an order placed while its plan is past due is set by the current order-fee basis, which supersedes it.

## One order, several fee types

A single order may carry more than one fee type (for example a same-day fee and a distance fee), each charged once. Each fee is booked against the order on the plan's charge ledger as its own entry.

## Hypothetical orders on Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery

| Order | Fees charged |
|---|---|
| Same-day, value $20.00, 3.2 miles | same-day fee $7.99 |
| Same-day, value $35.00, 3.2 miles | none (same-day fee waived) |
| Same-day, value $20.00, 8.1 miles | same-day fee $7.99 and distance fee $2.99 |
| Redelivery of a failed order, 3.2 miles | redelivery fee $4.99 |
| Same-day, value $20.00, prescriptions included, patient an active Kestrel Care Rewards member whose level carries free prescription delivery | none; a distance fee would still apply beyond 5 miles |

On the three Delivery Pass plans the free same-day threshold is $0.00, so rule 2's waiver by value never operates there (their same-day fee is itself $0.00).

superseded_clauses: An express_1hr order is charged express_1hr_fee_usd, waived while delivery_msr_free_express_month is below free_express_per_month.
Where the plan is past due and benefits_suspended_when_past_due is true, the Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery fees apply instead.
